actionPlan.name: Mission and Strategic Alignment
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Ensure cybersecurity strategy supports the organizational mission.

• Document the organizational mission and vision.
• Map cybersecurity objectives to business goals.
• Review alignment annually with leadership.

actionPlan.name: Internal & External Context
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Understand the internal and external environment that affects cybersecurity risk.

• Identify regulatory and legal requirements.
• Assess supplier and partner dependencies.
• Map threat landscape relevant to the org.

actionPlan.name: Legal & Regulatory Requirements
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Legal, regulatory and contractual cybersecurity obligations are understood.

• Catalog applicable laws (e.g. GDPR, HIPAA).
• Track changes to regulations.
• Assign ownership for each compliance area.

actionPlan.name: Identity & Credential Management
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Identities and credentials are managed throughout their lifecycle.

• Enforce MFA on all privileged and external accounts.
• Automate provisioning and de-provisioning.
• Review access rights quarterly.

actionPlan.name: Physical Access Control
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Physical access to assets is managed and protected.

• Use badge access and CCTV in sensitive areas.
• Log physical access to server rooms.
• Escort visitors in restricted zones.

actionPlan.name: Physical Device Inventory
actionPlan.customGuidance:
An inventory of physical devices and systems is maintained.

• Implement automated asset discovery (e.g. Nmap, Lansweeper).
• Document hardware specs, location, and owner.
• Track lifecycle from procurement to decommissioning.

actionPlan.name: Software & Platforms Inventory
actionPlan.customGuidance:
An inventory of software platforms and applications is maintained.

• Catalog all authorized software by version.
• Track license expiration and renewals.
• Detect and remove unauthorized applications.

actionPlan.name: Communication & Data Flows
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Communication and data flows are documented and mapped.

• Create network topology and data flow diagrams.
• Identify all external connections.
• Classify data flows by sensitivity.

actionPlan.name: Systems, Hardware & Software Lifecycle
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Systems, hardware, software and services are managed through their lifecycle.

• Define EOL policies for hardware and software.
• Plan timely replacements before EOL dates.
• Maintain records of decommissioned assets.

actionPlan.name: Inventories of Data
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Inventories of data and their corresponding information systems are maintained.

• Create a data inventory with classification labels.
• Map data to the systems that store or process it.
• Review data inventory after major system changes.

actionPlan.name: Improvements from Execution
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Improvements are identified from execution of operational processes.

• Review operational security metrics monthly.
• Identify bottlenecks or repeated failures.
• Feed lessons into process improvement cycles.

actionPlan.name: Improvements from Security Tests
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Plans and processes are improved based on security tests and exercises.

• Conduct tabletop exercises and red team exercises.
• Document gaps discovered and assign owners.
• Re-test after improvements are implemented.

actionPlan.name: Incident Lessons Learned
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Incident response plans incorporate lessons learned.

• Conduct post-incident reviews (PIRs) within 2 weeks.
• Update playbooks based on findings.
• Share non-sensitive lessons across the organization.

actionPlan.name: Incidents Contained for Limiting Impact
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Incidents are contained, mitigated, and newly identified vulnerabilities mitigated.

• Apply emergency patches or workarounds.
• Remove attacker persistence mechanisms.
• Monitor for re-infection after remediation.

actionPlan.name: Incidents Eradicated
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Incidents are eradicated and systems restored to a known good state.

• Rebuild or re-image compromised systems.
• Verify integrity of restored systems.
• Rescan for vulnerabilities after recovery.

actionPlan.name: Incident Response Plan Execution
actionPlan.customGuidance:
The incident response plan is executed and maintained.

• Activate IR plan immediately upon declaration.
• Follow pre-defined playbooks for common incident types.
• Test the plan at least annually.

actionPlan.name: Incident Reports Triaged
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Incident reports are triaged to ensure timely handling.

• Establish SLAs for triage (e.g. P1 within 15 min).
• Use a dedicated ticket queue for security incidents.
• Assign incident coordinators for each event.

actionPlan.name: Incidents Categorized & Prioritized
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Incidents are categorized and prioritized to guide response.

• Use a severity matrix based on impact and urgency.
• Maintain a priority queue in the IR ticketing system.
• Escalate high-severity incidents to leadership immediately.

actionPlan.name: Personnel Notified of Incident
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Internal stakeholders are notified of incidents in a timely manner.

• Define notification trees by incident severity.
• Use out-of-band communication channels (e.g. phone).
• Document time and method of notifications.

actionPlan.name: Information Shared Externally
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Information is shared with external partners per incident response plans.

• Report to regulators within required timeframes (e.g. 72 hrs for GDPR).
• Notify affected customers and partners as required.
• Coordinate disclosures with legal and PR teams.

actionPlan.name: Recovery Activities Communicated
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Recovery activities are communicated to internal and external stakeholders.

• Provide regular status updates during recovery.
• Use predefined templates for communications.
• Archive all communications for audit purposes.

actionPlan.name: Public Communications Coordinated
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Public communications about the recovery are coordinated with leadership.

• Align external statements with PR and legal.
• Avoid speculative or premature disclosures.
• Issue a formal post-incident summary when appropriate.

actionPlan.name: Networks Monitored
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Networks and network services are monitored for anomalies.

• Deploy IDS/IPS at network boundaries.
• Analyze NetFlow and packet captures.
• Alert on unusual traffic volumes or destinations.

actionPlan.name: Physical Environment Monitored
actionPlan.customGuidance:
The physical environment is monitored for unauthorized access.

• Install CCTV in key areas.
• Use environmental sensors (temp, humidity).
• Alert on after-hours physical access.

actionPlan.name: External Service Provider Activity Monitored
actionPlan.customGuidance:
External service provider activity is monitored for compliance.

• Log and review third-party access sessions.
• Require vendors to report security events.
• Audit vendor activity quarterly.

actionPlan.name: Computing Hardware & Software Monitored
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Computing hardware and software activities are monitored for anomalies.

• Deploy EDR on all endpoints.
• Alert on new processes, drivers, or registry changes.
• Monitor software inventory changes in real-time.

actionPlan.name: Potentially Adverse Events Analyzed
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Potentially adverse events are analyzed to understand attack targets and methods.

• Triage all security alerts within defined SLAs.
• Correlate events across multiple log sources.
• Tag events by MITRE ATT&CK technique.

actionPlan.name: Information Correlated from Multiple Sources
actionPlan.customGuidance:
Information is correlated from multiple sources to understand attacks.

• Integrate SIEM with threat intelligence platforms.
• Consume threat feeds in SIEM rules.
• Cross-reference indicators of compromise (IoCs).
• Pivot from indicators to broader threat actor profiles.

actionPlan.name: Estimated Impact of Adverse Events
actionPlan.customGuidance:
The estimated impact and scope of adverse events is understood.

• Classify events by severity and potential impact.
• Estimate affected assets and data.
• Update classification as investigations progress.
